text:
anna_docs: FYI I opened PR #842 to add a clearer network policy + HSM notes for private/on-prem installs. It contains a Calico example, iptables fallback, and a PKCS#11 snippet. Please review: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/842

sam_net: Which install targets are we documenting? k8s with Calico, and bare-metal systemd nodes? I can check the Calico rules but need the HSM port numbers (are we using vendor-managed TLS on 5696 and KMS proxy on 443?).

anna_docs: Targeting k8s (Calico) and a baremetal iptables example. For HSM we call out the vendor TCP port (5696) and the local KMS proxy on 443. Here's the Calico snippet I'm proposing — please sanity check:

```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-hsm-access
  namespace: redwood-serving
spec:
  selector: role == 'inference'
  ingress: []
  egress:
  - action: Allow
    protocol: TCP
    destination:
      nets: ["10.10.50.0/24"]   # HSM VLAN
      ports: [5696, 443]
  order: 1000
```

sam_net: Looks good. Suggest using a variable CIDR (HSM_VLAN_CIDR) in the docs and also recommend restricting source by namespace with a label selector rather than selector: role == 'inference' — change suggestion: `selector: app == 'redwood-runtime'` and add `source: namespaceSelector: matchLabels: team: platform`.

jules_sec: Quick security notes to include in the doc: 1) HSM appliances sometimes require outbound vendor URLs for firmware updates — call out that in air-gapped installs you must either provide those update servers via a controlled proxy or disable auto-update policies. 2) Add recommendation to create a dedicated k8s service account (e.g., `hsm-access-sa`) and annotate it for least privilege.

mike_support: Also reported by a customer: the install guide currently instructs adding host entries in step 4 before installing certs, which causes `curl: (60) SSL certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate` during the bootstrap. We should reorder: install certs -> update /etc/hosts -> run installer. Repro steps I saw: `./install.sh` fails at tls handshake when hosts file points to internal LB before CA is installed.

anna_docs: Good catches. I'll reorder the steps and add Jules' bullet points. Can someone validate the PKCS#11 example? I added this quick usage test for the docs:

```bash
# test PKCS#11 via pkcs11-tool (example)
export PKCS11_LIB=/opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so
pkcs11-tool --module "$PKCS11_LIB" --login --pin 1234 -O
```

and a short python snippet for the SDK (pseudo):

```python
from pkcs11 import Token, lib
pk = lib('/opt/hsm/lib/libpkcs11.so')
with pk.get_token(token_label='MyHSM').open(pin='1234') as token:
    priv = token.get_key(label='redwood-signing')
    sig = priv.sign(b"message")
    print(sig.hex())
```

sam_net: lgtm. small nit: in the Calico example replace the inline CIDR with `{{HSM_VLAN_CIDR}}` and mention cluster egress NATing tests. approving after that tweak.

jules_sec: +1 on the SA annotation and add a short note to restrict node egress where possible. Also add an explicit example of disabling auto-updates for an air-gapped install (one-liner to set vendor update URL to empty).

deploy-bot: docs-ci: build passed for PR #842 (checks: linkcheck ✅, asciidoc build ✅, spellcheck ⚠️ 1 warning).

anna_docs: Thanks all — I'll push edits in the branch, swap the host/certs ordering, add the `{{HSM_VLAN_CIDR}}` placeholder, and include Jules' airgap note. Marking the PR ready for merge after CI warning is addressed. Final PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/842

anna_docs: (follow-up) I've updated the PKCS#11 snippet to remove hardcoded PINs and added a short note about using a hardware-backed agent for key operations. Ready to merge once spellcheck warning is fixed. :tada:
